basis: Acute myeloid malignancy arising in bone marrow and blood; no common additional organ damage established.
Renal arterial disease causes malignant hypertension with hypertensive and ischemic kidney damage.
Immune-mediated pustular skin disease; arthritis is generally separately coded psoriatic arthritis. Geographic tongue and cheilitis do not establish lasting oral damage.
Hereditary peripheral motor neuron disease; weakness and muscle wasting reflect denervation rather than a separate primary muscle process.
Electrical conduction block involving the sinoatrial node.
Localized benign breast neoplasm; breast has no axis. Endothelial histology does not establish systemic cardiovascular disease.
Cerebellar malformations, developmental impairment and congenital cardiac defects define this cerebello-cardio-craniofacial syndrome.
Limb malformations, cardiac defects and intellectual disability define the syndrome; cleft lip/palate affects 30-79%, involving oral structures.
Recurrent hepatic failure/fibrosis and cerebellar degeneration with sensorimotor neuropathy define SCYL1 disease; muscle wasting is neurogenic.
Tumor or proliferative lesion arising from peripheral nerve tissue.
Cutaneous hamartoma containing proliferating eccrine sweat glands and small vascular channels.
Central nervous system neoplasm composed of neuronal and anaplastic glial elements.
Syndrome defined by inclusion body myopathy, Pagetic bone disease and variable frontotemporal degeneration; cognitive impairment reported in 2/5.
Squamous cell carcinoma originating in skin.
Acute myeloid leukemia defined by a FUS-ERG-associated chromosomal translocation; marrow and blood are the primary sites.
Cerebral small-vessel arteriopathy with defining white-matter injury and recurrent subcortical infarction.
Chronic bacterial infection; cervicofacial infiltrative soft-tissue/subcutaneous abscesses occur in roughly 50-60%. Thoracic and abdominal disease are less common.
Platelet dysfunction, immunodeficiency and severe CNS disease define HPS10; ocular albinism impairs vision (~all). Cap excludes skin findings and reported ILD (1/1).
Localized inherited skin fragility with palmoplantar blistering and nail dystrophy.
Skeletal dysplasia with enlarged epiphyses and severe short stature; inferior lens subluxation is a characteristic syndromic feature, frequency unquantified.
Ectodermal defects, hypothyroidism and respiratory ciliary dysfunction define disease; lacrimal dysfunction occurs in 30-79%. Enteropathy omitted under cap; frequency unclear.
Localized cavernous vascular neoplasm arising in the colon.
Inherited small-eye disorder with bilateral microphthalmos; no additional organ involvement established for this concept.
Acute inflammation of the lacrimal drainage apparatus; an infectious or autoimmune cause is not specified.
Aggressive carcinoma originating in renal medulla; pulmonary metastases directly occupy lung in roughly 40-50%. Liver and bone metastases are less frequent.
